g.text: Upload, Transcode, Playback -- Three Paths, Five Blocks
The manifest is the hinge: transcoding writes to it, playback reads from it, and neither path touches the other directly.
Creator -> Upload Service (pre-signed URL) -> Object Storage (direct PUT) -> Queue (enqueue transcode job)
Queue -> Transcoding Worker (claims job) -> Object Storage (write segments, staging) -> Manifest Service (promote to ready)
Viewer -> Manifest Service (GET manifest) -> CDN (GET segment) -> Object Storage (cache miss only, dashed)
